name: zim-e2e
description: The ZIM end-to-end suite (M25): drives the real engine binary (embedded frontend, real TLS, real runtime) through a headless Chromium, plus the offline migration flow. Tier model: 'docker' where a Docker daemon answers (full lifecycle), 'null' elsewhere (boot/login/UI/session/extensions/files/backups/schedules/themes/migration + degraded-runtime behavior).
